scope: One-variable reverse-valuation diagnostic, not a revised forecast or a measured market expectation. Hardware reviewer has not seen these results before independent margin judgment.
fixed: All revenues,2027–2030margins,capital,WC,taxes,claims,financing andpackaging fixed. Increase group EBIT by a rising incremental margin on the whole DCAI revenue base from2031, reaching the target in2040. No double manufacturing benefit.
method: Each extra terminal percentage point adds DCAI revenue ×0.01×min((year−2030)/10,1) to EBIT after2030, taxed at the existing operating rate. All extra cash is after2030, so endpoint2026/2030 net cash is unchanged.
limits: End2026 value uses forecast financial balances; matching58.11 is not an exact as-of-November4market-implied inversion.
Many combinations of revenue, capital productivity, operating risk, packaging and margins can explain a share price. This diagnostic identifies only one conditional combination.
Higher margins do not themselves require extra volume in this diagnostic; it is not evidence that the resulting costs are achievable.
Do not select a central margin simply to match the price or create an attractive target.
